data.title: Imperial Brands Stock Up On Altria's Confirmation Of Possible Takeover Offer
data.description:
HENRICO COUNTY (dpa-AFX) - Shares of Imperial Brands PLC (IMBBY.PK, IMB.L) climbed around 15 percent on Thursday's London trading after U.S. tobacco major Altria Group, Inc. (MO) confirmed a possible takeover offer for the British peer.

Meanwhile, responding to Altria's statement, Imperial Brands said its Board has not had any discussions with, or received any approach or proposal from, Altria or the third party referenced.

Earlier in the day, Altria Group issued a statement in response to recent press speculation, confirming that it is considering a possible offer for Imperial Brands. Any offer, if made, is likely to be solely in cash.

Altria confirmed that it is also in discussions with a third party regarding its possible acquisition of part of the business of Imperial Brands.

However, the companies have not reached any agreement so far. There can be no certainty that an offer will ultimately be made nor as to the terms on which any offer may be made, it said.

Altria is required to announce a firm intention to make an offer for Imperial Brands by no later than December 24, or that it does not intend to make an offer.

Following the news, Imperial Brands said its Board is clear in its duty of aiming to maximise shareholder value and will consider any proposal, should one be made. The firm also urged shareholders not to take any action at this time.

Imperial Brands added that it has strong confidence in its strategy and trading.

On November 17, Imperial Brands reported a drop in pre-tax income and revenue for fiscal 2026, and said it expects fiscal 2027 adjusted operating profit to grow at a similar level to fiscal 2026, on a constant currency basis, primarily driven by continued profit growth from the company's combustible tobacco business.

While reporting the results, the firm also had announced planned job cuts as part of its transformation strategy, which is estimated to generate cost savings of at least 320 million pounds per annum by 2030.

In fiscal year 2026, the company projects reduction of 2,100 roles globally. Additionally, the Bristol-based company plans for a further reduction of between 2,100 and 2,500 roles by the end of 2030.

In London, Imperial Brands shares closed Thursday's trading at 3,432.00 pence, up 14.85 percent.

In the overnight activity on the NYSE, Altria shares were trading 0.33 percent lower at $76.03, after closing Thursday's regular trading 1.95 percent higher.

data.title: Five-Year Treasury Yields Seen Anchored by Fed Outlook — Market Talk
data.description: The Federal Reserve rate-path outlook should provide a firmer anchor for five-year rates, Societe Generale rates strategists say in a note. "A restrictive policy path is already largely reflected in market pricing, leaving less room for five-year rates to rise materially without a further hawkish repricing of the Fed outlook," they say. As U.S. growth and inflation gradually moderate, the intermediate sector of the Treasury curve should remain anchored by the expected policy path, they say. The five-year Treasury yield last trades 7.1 basis points higher at 4.730%, according to Tradeweb. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)

data.title: Prisjakt publishes interim report for Q3 2026
data.description:
Prisjakt AB (publ) publishes its interim report for the third quarter of 2026. The interim report is available on the company’s website and is attached to this press release.

Third quarter

  • Net revenue increased by 10.5% to SEK 127.6 million (115.5).
  • Click-outs increased by 2% to 31.7 million.
  • Adjusted EBITDA amounted to SEK 45.0 million (45.3), corresponding to a margin of 35.3% (39.2).
  • Operating profit (EBIT) amounted to SEK 25.9 million (27.4).
  • Profit for the period amounted to SEK 17.2 million (14.5).
  • Earnings per share after dilution amounted to SEK 0.80 (0.70).

January - September 2026

  • Net revenue amounted to SEK 370.9 million.
  • Click-outs increased by 7% to 93.1 million.
  • Adjusted EBITDA amounted to SEK 127.5 million, corresponding to a margin of 34.4%.
  • Operating profit (EBIT) amounted to SEK 64.9 million.
  • Profit for the period amounted to SEK 40.0 million.
  • Cash flow from operating activities amounted to SEK 110.4 million.
  • Net debt / adjusted EBITDA (LTM) amounted to 0.9x at 30 September 2026.

Following the acquisition of the operating subsidiaries in June 2025, the Group's IFRS comparative figures for January–September 2025 are not directly comparable. Based on historical financial information for the Prisjakt Sverige AB Group, prepared in accordance with Swedish GAAP (K3), net revenue increased by 14.9% and adjusted EBITDA by 35.8% for January–September 2026 compared with the same period last year. This information is supplementary to the IFRS financial statements. For further details, see the interim report.

Peter Greberg, CEO of Prisjakt, comments

"In October, Prisjakt was listed on Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market. In the same month, we launched our AI shopping assistant and expanded our geographic presence to eleven markets through our launch in Spain, the Netherlands and Poland. In the third quarter, net revenue increased by 10.5% and the adjusted EBITDA margin was 35.3%. We are entering the holiday shopping season with a strengthened offering and will continue to develop our services with a focus on creating greater value for both consumers and retailers."

data.title: Dolphin Drilling AS: Third Quarter 2026 Results
data.description:
Oslo, 27 November 2026

Dolphin Drilling AS ("Dolphin Drilling" or the "Company", Euronext Growth Oslo: DDRIL) today announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026.

Dolphin Drilling delivered strong operations in the third quarter and is now close to having both of its owned rigs on long-term contracts. From December 2026, Paul B. Loyd, Jr. and Borgland Dolphin will both be working under long-term contracts, backed by a firm revenue backlog of about USD 513 million and up to USD 663 million in options. Following the sale of the semi-submersible drilling rig Blackford Dolphin, the Company no longer carries the rig's ownership costs or the capital investments previously expected, while the joint venture with SPM Energy Shipping FZCO (“SPM”) gives Dolphin Drilling a capital-light platform for growth in rig management.

Highlights

  • Long-term visibility: firm revenue backlog of about USD 513 million, plus up to USD 663 million in options. Paul B. Loyd, Jr. is firm to September 2030 and Borgland Dolphin to November 2031.
  • Borgland Dolphin back to work: the rig is scheduled to leave the yard in early December and commence its contract with Repsol following transit to location.
  • Strong operations: Paul B. Loyd, Jr. delivered 100% uptime and 96.9% earnings efficiency; Blackford Dolphin delivered 99.6% uptime, with 95.2% earnings efficiency, up from 89.8%.
  • Blackford Dolphin sold: the Oil India contract ended on 21 September and the rig has since been sold to Voyage Shipping Inc., a guaranteed nominee of SPM.
  • Joint Venture Agreement: Dolphin Drilling and SPM have entered into a joint venture agreement to pursue drilling contracts in India and potentially other regions, creating management opportunities for Dolphin Drilling .
  • Revenue of USD 41.9 million in Q3 2026 (Q2 2026: USD 44.9 million)
  • EBITDA of USD 1.9 million in Q3 2026 (Q2: USD 7.0 million), after USD 6.3 million of costs to prepare Borgland Dolphin for its new contract and USD 1.0 million of net Blackford Dolphin demobilisation costs. Adjusted for these items, EBITDA was USD 9.2 million in Q3 2026 (Q2: USD 9.4 million).
  • Year to date: EBITDA of USD 17.2 million for the first nine months of 2026, up from USD 5.7 million in the same period of 2025, representing an increase of 202%.
  • Lower overheads: G&A of USD 4.3 million in Q3 2026, down from USD 5.2 million in Q2 2026, which included refinancing costs.
  • Net result: net loss of USD 11.4 million in Q3 2026 (Q2 2026: USD 2.3 million), including a USD 3.5 million currency loss.
  • Cash flow in Q3 2026: operating cash flow of USD 4.7 million. Investing cash flow of USD 11.1 million, mainly USD 10.8 million of Borgland Dolphin class renewal capex.
  • Financial position: cash, including restricted cash, of USD 53.0 million as of end Q3 2026 (31 December 2025: USD 30.5 million) and an equity ratio of 33.5% (31 December 2025: 12.2%), following the USD 65 million equity raise in May 2026.

"The sale of Blackford Dolphin and the joint venture with SPM are strategically important steps for Dolphin Drilling. The sale materially reduces our operating cost base, eliminates the forthcoming class-renewal capital expenditure and significantly de-risks the balance sheet. The joint venture gives us a capital-light platform for growth and positions us to expand the number of rigs under our management. We are shifting gear towards a more flexible, capital-light approach, with priority on strategic initiatives, partnerships and long-term value creation for our shareholders," says Ronny Bjørnådal, Executive Chairman of Dolphin Drilling.

Outlook

Borgland Dolphin is scheduled to complete its renewal survey in Las Palmas in early December 2026 and commence its contract with Repsol in Spain. Both owned rigs will then be on long-term contracts, with Paul B. Loyd, Jr. firm to September 2030 and Borgland Dolphin to November 2031. Fourth-quarter results will reflect the end of the Blackford Dolphin contract in September, remaining reactivation costs and capex for Borgland Dolphin ahead of contract start, and revenue from the commencement of Borgland Dolphin. From 2027, both owned rigs are scheduled to be on contract for the full year. Following the sale of Blackford Dolphin, the Company no longer carries the rig's ownership costs or capex, and could earn management fees if the joint venture with SPM secures work for the rig, as well as for one or more SPM-owned semi-submersible drilling rigs.

"Paul B. Loyd, Jr. achieved 100% uptime in the quarter on the new Harbour Energy contract, and Blackford Dolphin completed its Oil India campaign with strong performance. This quarter's earnings carry the cost of getting Borgland Dolphin ready for its contract. With Borgland Dolphin starting work for Repsol, both our owned rigs will be on long-term contracts. Our focus now is on safe and efficient operations, and on turning a firm backlog of more than half a billion dollars into cash flow," says Michael Boyd, CEO of Dolphin Drilling.

Market

The market for moored semi-submersibles remains tight. The international active moored semi-submersible fleet has contracted by 89% since 2014, with only around 15 moored semi-submersibles remaining and no newbuild cycle in sight. Recent day rates for moored semi-submersibles have been in the range of USD 150,000–300,000 per day. On the demand side, floater contract awards in 2026 are already above the full-year 2025 level, and offshore E&P spending is expected to grow by 17% by 2030, with well capex, the most rig-intensive part, up 31%. These market fundamentals underpin the potential exercise of contract options on Paul B. Loyd, Jr. and Borgland Dolphin, favourable terms on future contracts, and growing demand for the Company's management services for third-party rigs.

"Our operational platform remains strong, and what gives me real confidence is that the market backdrop continues to support our strategy. The international moored semi-submersible fleet is tight, with limited supply and solid demand across key regions, and the pipeline of attractive opportunities is high, both for our own rigs and for our management services," says Ronny Bjørnådal.

Presentation and webcast

Dolphin Drilling will present its third quarter 2026 results today, 27 November 2026, at 14:00 CET. The presentation will be held by Executive Chairman Ronny Bjørnådal, Chief Executive Officer Michael Boyd and Chief Financial Officer Ingolf Gillesdal. The quarterly report and presentation materials are attached to this announcement and available at The offshore drilling pioneer - Dolphin Drilling.

For further information, please contact:

Ronny Bjørnådal

Executive Chairman

Mobile: +47 918 50 549

E-mail: ronny@bjornadal.info

Ingolf Gillesdal

Chief Financial Officer

Mobile: +47 920 45 320

E-mail: ingolf.gillesdal@dolphindrilling.com

About Dolphin Drilling

Dolphin Drilling AS, headquartered in Aberdeen, UK, is an owner and operator of a fleet of harsh-environment mid-water and deep-water semi-submersible drilling rigs capable of working worldwide, with a long track record of safe and efficient operations. The Company owns two harsh-environment mid/deep-water semi-submersible drilling rigs and has prospects for further semi-submersible rigs under management.

data.title: Cereno Scientific appoints Anders Svensson as Acting Chairperson of the Board – Nomination Committee reviews Board composition
data.description:
Cereno Scientific (Nasdaq First North: CRNO B), an innovative biotech pioneering treatments to enhance and extend life for people with rare cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases, today announced that the Nomination Committee is reviewing the composition of the Company’s Board of Directors. The Board has appointed Anders Svensson as Acting Chairperson of the Board to ensure continuity and stability in the work of the Board.

Anders Svensson has been a member of Cereno Scientific’s Board of Directors since 2018, contributing his extensive expertise in international drug development and cardiovascular medicine. With nearly 20 years of experience in senior positions within the global pharmaceutical industry, including at Roche and AstraZeneca, as well as a strong scientific and clinical background, Anders brings valuable expertise to Cereno’s continued development.

His deep understanding of the Company’s operations, strategy and clinical development programs, combined with his international experience in drug development, is an important asset at Cereno’s current stage of development.

Sten R. Sörensen, CEO and Board member of Cereno Scientific, commented: “Anders has been a highly valued member of Cereno’s Board of Directors for many years. His extensive experience in global drug development and deep expertise in cardiovascular medicine are of significant value to the Company. I am very pleased that Anders is now taking on the role of Acting Chairperson of the Board. Together, we remain focused on executing our financing plans and advancing our clinical development programs.”

Next steps

In light of the recent changes to the Board of Directors, the Nomination Committee is reviewing the Board’s composition, taking into account the Company’s current and future needs. The Nomination Committee’s proposal will be announced as soon as possible.

An Extraordinary General Meeting will be held to consider the Nomination Committee’s proposal and decide on the composition of the Board of Directors. The notice of the Extraordinary General Meeting will be published separately.

For further information, please contact:

Tove Bergenholt, Head of IR & Communications

Email: tove.bergenholt@cerenoscientific.com

Phone: +46 73- 236 62 46

About Cereno Scientific AB

Cereno Scientific is pioneering treatments to enhance and extend life. The company’s innovative pipeline offers disease-modifying drug candidates to empower people suffering from rare cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases to live life to the fullest.

Lead candidate CS1 is an HDAC inhibitor that works through epigenetic modulation and represents a novel therapeutic approach by targeting the underlying mechanisms of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). CS1 is a well-tolerated oral therapy with a favorable safety profile that has shown encouraging efficacy signals in a Phase IIa trial in patients with PAH, including improvements in right heart function, functional class, risk score and patient quality of life, with early signs consistent with reverse vascular remodeling. An Expanded Access Program confirmed CS1 to be well-tolerated with a favorable safety profile over 12 months of treatment and showed that a majority of patients completing treatment maintained or improved clinical status. CS1 is currently being evaluated in EPIMODE, a global, placebo-controlled Phase IIb trial in PAH. CS014 is a new chemical entity and HDAC inhibitor with a multimodal mechanism of action as an epigenetic modulator having the potential to address the underlying pathophysiology of a range of cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases with high unmet needs. CS014 showed a favorable safety and tolerability profile in Phase I, and is being advanced through a streamlined, FDA-aligned pathway toward Phase IIb in pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD). Cereno Scientific is also advancing the preclinical program CS585, an oral, highly potent and selective prostacyclin (IP) receptor agonist shown to prevent thrombosis without increased bleeding risk, currently being evaluated in antiphospholipid syndrome (APS).

The Company is headquartered in GoCo Health Innovation City in Gothenburg, Sweden, and has a US subsidiary, Cereno Scientific Inc., located in Kendall Square, Boston. Cereno Scientific is listed on the Nasdaq First North (CRNO B). The Company’s Certified Adviser is DNB Carnegie Investment Bank AB, certifiedadviser@carnegie.se. More information can be found on www.cerenoscientific.com.
